symbols.name: input bit length
symbols.meaning: The number of bits in each of the two input integers.
symbols.quote: Let $n$ be the number of bits in each of the two input integers.

symbols.name: running time
symbols.meaning: The running time of machine A as a function of the input length n.
symbols.quote: Let $T_A(n)$ be the running time of a machine $A$ on inputs of that length.

symbols.name: multiplication machine
symbols.meaning: A fixed Turing machine that multiplies two integers, whose running time is T_A.
symbols.quote: Let $T_A(n)$ be the running time of a machine $A$ on inputs of that length.

symbols.name: lower-bound constant
symbols.meaning: A positive constant, depending on machine A, in the lower bound T_A(n) >= c_A n log n.
symbols.quote: For a machine $A$, let $c_A > 0$ be a constant and $N_A$ a threshold input length, both depending on $A$.

symbols.name: threshold input length
symbols.meaning: The input length from which the lower bound for machine A holds.
symbols.quote: For a machine $A$, let $c_A > 0$ be a constant and $N_A$ a threshold input length, both depending on $A$.

relations.quote: In this model the conjecture is refuted through one machine whose ratio $T_A(n)/(n \log n)$ has [limit inferior](limit-inferior.md) zero.
